Flow.description: Record-page-level double-booking guard, complementing the picker's own real-time slot check (AF_TestDriveSchedulerController.getBookedSlots). Conflict key is exact AF_Vehicle__c + AF_Location__c + AF_TestDriveDateTime__c match on another record — the scheduler always derives AF_TestDriveDateTime__c deterministically from Date + AF_TimeSlot__c, so two bookings for the same vehicle/showroom/date/slot always produce identical DateTime values. AF_Location__c (Location/Showroom) was added 2026-09-14 per business request: the same vehicle+time slot should only block within the SAME showroom, leaving a different showroom free to book that slot. NOTE: AF_Location__c is free text entered per Test Drive record, not a validated picklist or a value derived from the Vehicle - it is NOT guaranteed consistent across records for the same physical Vehicle (confirmed live in DEV, e.g. one Vehicle has Location values "test"/"Test"/"53" across its own Test Drives). This is a deliberate accepted tradeoff of this request: two bookings for the exact same physical vehicle at the exact same time CAN now both succeed if the showroom text differs, even though a vehicle cannot physically be in two showrooms at once. If double-booking of the same physical vehicle resurfaces, standardize AF_Location__c (e.g. to a picklist or a lookup) before revisiting this flow. Refused bookings don't hold the slot (LFRDN-623). Note 2026-09-09: the "Cancelled" status value was retired — Refused is now the sole "this booking won't happen" state, so the separate Cancelled exclusion was removed as redundant, not a behavior change.

start.filterFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.AF_Vehicle__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.AF_TestDriveDateTime__c})), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED({!$Record.AF_Vehicle__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.AF_TestDriveDateTime__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.AF_Location__c}) ) )
